decisions.reason: Removing navigation from the shared header and placing links in the footer does not change the requirement that follow-on pages share the same header and footer.
The navigation-location decision does not change the responsive breakpoint guidance applied across website pages.
The source concerns website header navigation and footer links, not the distinct SaaS console shell header, side navigation panel, or footer.
Moving site-navigation links from the header to the footer does not change whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The landing-page visual choices remain valid unchanged; navigation placement is represented by the dedicated website-footer requirement rather than this visual-system requirement.
The header-navigation removal does not alter the How It Works section's position, sequential presentation, or listed steps.
The website navigation decision does not change the requirement to apply Actia branding to the AWS Cognito sign-in page.
Navigation placement does not change the selected plain HTML and Tailwind CSS implementation stack or the decision not to use Astro.
Removing header navigation and relocating links to the footer does not change the requirement for responsive landing-page behavior.
The sign-up button remains required regardless of whether general site-navigation links appear in the header or footer.
The source decision concerns website navigation chrome and does not resolve or alter any provisioning-wizard visual specification.
